rule_description: An entity name must be unique within the design library (no duplicate entity declarations)
Port names within a single entity declaration must be unique
Generic names within a single entity declaration must be unique
An architecture name must be unique within the corresponding entity
The entity_name in an architecture body must reference a previously declared entity
A configuration declaration must reference an existing entity
Block specification in configuration must reference a valid architecture or block
Component specification must reference a declared component
A function must contain at least one return statement in every execution path
A pure function must not reference or modify any signals or variables declared outside the function
Function formal parameters of mode OUT or INOUT are not permitted (only IN allowed)
Procedure formal parameter names must be unique within the parameter list
Subprogram body parameter list must conform to its declaration parameter list
A subprogram body must have a corresponding declaration if the declaration exists
Package name must be unique within the design library
A package body must have a corresponding package declaration
Items declared in package body must have been declared in the package declaration
A type name must be unique within its declarative region
Index subtype in array type definition must be a discrete type
Element type in array type definition must be a valid type or subtype
Record element names must be unique within the record type
Range constraint bounds must be of the same discrete type
Range constraint left bound must be a locally static expression of the index type
Enumeration literal identifiers must be unique within the enumeration type definition
Primary unit declaration in physical type must be a valid identifier
Integer type range bounds must be locally static expressions
Floating type range bounds must be locally static expressions
Subtype indication in access type definition must denote a valid type
Type mark in file type definition must denote an existing type
An incomplete type declaration must have a corresponding full type declaration in the same declarative region
Full type declaration corresponding to an incomplete type must be in the same declarative region
Signal subtype indication must denote a valid type or subtype
Signal default expression (if present) must be of the same type as the signal
Register kind signal declaration is only permitted within a process statement
Variable default expression must be of the same type as the variable subtype
Shared variable type must be a protected type
A deferred constant declaration must have a corresponding full constant declaration in the package body
Constant initial value expression must be of the same type as the constant subtype
The name referenced in an alias declaration must be a valid static name
Alias subtype indication (if present) must be compatible with the aliased object type
Attribute type mark must reference a valid type or subtype
The entity specification in an attribute specification must reference a valid named entity
Component local port names must be unique
Component local generic names must be unique
Component specification must reference a previously declared component
Every identifier used as a name must have a visible declaration
Selected name prefix must denote a valid package, library, or design unit
Number of indices in an indexed name must match the array type dimensionality
Slice range direction must match the array index direction
Attribute name prefix must belong to a class for which the attribute is defined
Binary operator operands must be of compatible types
Logical operators (and, or, nand, nor, xor, xnor, not) require operands of type BIT, BOOLEAN, or array of BIT/BOOLEAN
Relational operators require operands of the same type
Adding operators (+/-) require numeric operands
Multiplication operators require numeric operands (integer or floating point)
The & (concatenation) operator requires operands of the same array element type or one array and one element
Aggregate element associations must be compatible with the array or record element types
Named association in an aggregate requires a record type target
Aggregate must provide associations for all elements of the target type (positional for array, or all record fields)
Number of actual parameters must match the number of formal parameters in the function declaration
Actual parameter types must be compatible with formal parameter types
Qualified expression type mark must denote an existing type
Qualified expression operand must be of the type indicated by the type mark
Type conversion between unrelated types is not permitted
Allocator subtype indication must denote an existing type or subtype
Numeric literal value must be within the range of the target type
Target of a signal assignment must be a signal (not a variable, constant, or port of mode IN)
Waveform expression type must match the target signal type
Target of a variable assignment must be a variable (not a signal or constant)
Assignment expression type must match the target variable type
IF statement condition expression must be of type BOOLEAN
Case statement expression must be of a discrete type or a one-dimensional array of characters
Case statement choices must cover all possible values of the expression type
Each value of the case expression type must be covered exactly once across all choices
Case statement choice values must be of the same type as the case expression
FOR loop parameter must be of a discrete type in the iteration scheme range
WHILE loop condition must be of type BOOLEAN
WAIT statement is not permitted inside a process with a sensitivity list
WAIT statement condition clause expression must be of type BOOLEAN
Assert condition expression must be of type BOOLEAN
Report expression must be of type STRING
Severity expression must be of type SEVERITY_LEVEL
Return expression type in a function must match the function return type
RETURN statement in a procedure must not contain an expression
NEXT statement loop label must reference an enclosing loop
EXIT statement loop label must reference an enclosing loop
NEXT statement condition must be of type BOOLEAN
EXIT statement condition must be of type BOOLEAN
Number of actual parameters in procedure call must match the number of formal parameters
Actual parameter types in procedure call must be compatible with formal parameter types
Force assignment is only valid in a process or subprogram (not in concurrent context)
Release assignment target must reference a currently forced signal
A process sensitivity list must contain only signal names
Signals in a process sensitivity list must be readable by the process
Instantiated unit name must reference a declared component, entity, or configuration
Port map actual signals must be compatible with component port types
Port map actuals must match port modes: IN port connected to expression/signal, OUT port connected to signal
Generic map actual expressions must be compatible with component generic types
Actual port of mode IN cannot be connected to an aggregate or open
Unassociated input ports must have a default expression in the component or entity declaration
Block guard condition expression must be of type BOOLEAN
FOR generate parameter must be of a discrete type
IF generate condition must be a locally static expression of type BOOLEAN
Target of a concurrent signal assignment must be a signal
Waveform types must match the target signal type in concurrent signal assignment
Concurrent procedure call must reference a valid procedure
Use clause selected name must reference a valid package or design unit
Name referenced after USE must be a visible declaration
Two declarations with the same identifier must not occur in the same declarative region
A declaration must not hide another declaration with the same name in the same immediate scope
A design unit name must be unique within the design library (entity, architecture, package, configuration)
Library clause name must reference an existing design library
Library clause is required before referencing any design unit from that library
Matching case statement requires exact coverage of all expression values (more strict than regular case)
Condition operator (??) operand must be of type BIT or STD_ULOGIC
Each condition in a conditional expression must be of type BOOLEAN
Context declaration name must be unique within the design library
External name pathname must reference a valid object in the design hierarchy
Force assignment effective mode must be compatible with the target signal
Package instantiation generic map must match the uninstantiated package formal generics
Subprogram instantiation generic map must match the uninstantiated subprogram formal generics
Protected type method declarations must have corresponding method bodies in the protected type body
Case generate expression must be of a discrete type or one-dimensional character array
Case generate alternatives must cover all possible values of the expression type
Formal port mode IN cannot be updated (assigned) in the architecture body
Formal port of mode OUT or INOUT cannot be read in the architecture body
Buffer ports have restricted connectivity: only one source, must connect to OUT or BUFFER
Port map association element formal part must reference a valid port of the instantiated unit
Generic map association element must reference a valid generic of the instantiated unit
Association element formal part type must match the actual part type
A resolved signal may have multiple drivers only if the resolution function is defined for the type
Conditional signal assignment conditions must be of type BOOLEAN
Selected signal assignment choices must cover all possible values of the select expression
Conditional variable assignment conditions must be of type BOOLEAN
Selected variable assignment choices must cover all possible values of the select expression
Direct entity instantiation must reference an existing entity declaration
Configuration must bind all component instances to entities and architectures
Generic map must provide values for all generics or generics must have default values
Port map must provide connections for all ports or ports must have default values
